activities.name: Invoke
activities.whenToUse: Use to route an Invoke-labeled conduction request to the selected mapped slot. Conduction_ST reads the full Plan and its Phases; Conduction_SDA's five-argument source invokes its own conductor without reading the forwarded Plan. This label alone does not guarantee a value Result.

properties.description: Describe the full plan when a phase is invoked.
properties.whenToUse: For Conduction_ST, supply a full-plan Description when phase invocation telemetry should carry that text; omit when no description is needed. This catalog property is not attributed to Conduction_SDA.

properties.description: Control conduction and phase telemetry emission.
properties.whenToUse: For Conduction_ST, set true to suppress conduction and phase telemetry emission; omit or false to leave those traces enabled. This property is not attributed to Conduction_SDA.

properties.description: Attach the original plan identifier to telemetry.
properties.whenToUse: For Conduction_ST, supply the original Plan Id when telemetry should retain its identifier. This property is not attributed to Conduction_SDA.

properties.description: Name the conduction operation and its telemetry.
properties.whenToUse: For Conduction_ST, name the conduction operation for plan identity and telemetry. This property is not attributed to Conduction_SDA.

properties.description: Select and order phases for conduction.
properties.whenToUse: For Conduction_ST, supply Phases to order and execute. The ST conductor builds a phase grid and selects phase sets from this collection; Conduction_SDA applicability is not declared here.

properties.description: Read direct phase DependsOn for dependency ordering.
properties.whenToUse: For a direct Conduction_ST phase, set DependsOn to match a current predecessor name or wildcard *. Root selection also matches empty DependsOn or *; this is not an all-predecessors-completed barrier.

properties.description: Attach the phase identifier to telemetry.
properties.whenToUse: For a Conduction_ST phase, supply Id when phase telemetry should retain that identifier.

properties.description: Read phase Mappings for subsequent processing.
properties.whenToUse: For a Conduction_ST phase, supply Mappings when its mapping steps should be processed. This is distinct from PostMappings.

properties.description: Attempt the mapping-relative jacket/result virtual-path lookup.
properties.whenToUse: For a Conduction_ST phase mapping, provide a jacket/result VirtualPath only where the mapping-relative lookup is intended; source attempts this lookup and may have no result.

properties.description: Read mapping Action to order or dispatch the step.
properties.whenToUse: For a Conduction_ST mapping step, set Action when the phase processor should use it for ordering or dispatch.

properties.description: Read mapping Activity to order or dispatch the step.
properties.whenToUse: For a Conduction_ST mapping step, set Activity for the selected downstream operation when phase processing reaches dispatch.

properties.description: Read mapping Adapter to order or dispatch the step.
properties.whenToUse: For a Conduction_ST mapping step, set Adapter to identify the mapped adapter for downstream dispatch.

properties.description: Read mapping Name to order or dispatch the step.
properties.whenToUse: For a Conduction_ST mapping step, set Name to identify the step in ordering and trace context.

properties.description: Read mapping Order to order or dispatch the step.
properties.whenToUse: For a Conduction_ST mapping step, set Order when explicit mapping order is needed.

properties.description: Read direct phase Name for dependency ordering.
properties.whenToUse: For a direct Conduction_ST phase, set Name for dependency ordering and phase identification.

properties.description: Read direct phase Order for dependency ordering.
properties.whenToUse: For a direct Conduction_ST phase, set Order when explicit phase ordering is needed.

properties.description: Read PostMappings into a follow-up Mappings plan; current Memory.Generate consumes Steps, so this does not establish execution.
properties.whenToUse: For a Conduction_ST phase, PostMappings is read and forwarded as Mappings in a follow-up Memory.Generate plan. Current Memory.Generate consumes Steps instead, so this forwarding does not establish execution of those post mappings.

properties.description: Control phase repetition using RepeatCount.
properties.whenToUse: For a Conduction_ST phase, set RepeatCount when phase execution should repeat; omission uses the source default zero.

properties.description: Control phase repetition using RepeatDelayMS.
properties.whenToUse: For a Conduction_ST phase, set RepeatDelayMS when repeated phases need a delay; omission uses the source default zero milliseconds.

properties.description: Unwrap a single-key phase dictionary.
properties.whenToUse: For a single-key wrapped Conduction_ST phase dictionary, supply the only child phase object to unwrap before dependency selection. This is a dynamic key context, not a fixed property name.

properties.description: Read wrapped phase DependsOn for dependency ordering.
properties.whenToUse: Within a single-key wrapped Conduction_ST phase, set DependsOn to match the current predecessor name or wildcard *. Root selection also matches empty DependsOn or *; it does not verify all listed predecessors completed.

properties.description: Read wrapped phase Name for dependency ordering.
properties.whenToUse: Within a single-key wrapped Conduction_ST phase, set Name for dependency ordering and phase identification.

properties.description: Read wrapped phase Order for dependency ordering.
properties.whenToUse: Within a single-key wrapped Conduction_ST phase, set Order when explicit phase ordering is needed.

resultNotes: No stable public Result field is available for this activity; inspect the Signal/effect at its actual boundary.
Conduction_ST: success can have no Result (underlying conductor completes; mapped wrapper calls GetResult(value) rather than SetResult)
Conduction_ST: Concrete class may yield ItemSignal, but public mapped boundary loses it
Conduction_SDA: success can have no Result (SDA conductor completes; mapped wrapper drops returned result)
Conduction_SDA: Catalog property adapters name only Conduction_ST although Conduction_SDA is mapped; source applicability differs from declaration
